svg.title: physics_behaviour_EMV — framework schematic
svg.desc: Architecture of the physics-informed social-force framework for emergency-vehicle yielding: inputs, the per-step simulation core, measurement and analysis, two-stage identification, couplings to SUMO and Unreal Engine, and the reproducibility layer.
svg.text: physics_behaviour_EMV—how traffic yields to an emergency vehicle (EV)
A physics-informed social-force framework: every car is a Newtonian particle under superimposed forces, a perception model
decides when each driver feels the EV, calibration against real trajectories sets how strongly, and bridges put it in SUMO and Unreal Engine.
every constant with unit + literature anchor

g.text: + baselines with the EV inert (no yielding)

svg.text: ② SIMULATION CORE · emv/simulate.py Sim.step() · ONE STEP EVERY Δt = 0.05 s

→ a “bow wave”: onset ≈ 100 m ahead, widest clearance d* at the EV
